title: Resource-complementary PD candidate screening
subtitle: H200 measurements with the strongest tested physical control in each direction
note: The online status applies to proposed candidates. The study includes native online PD and EP baselines.

directions.finding: The joint round-trip gate passed in 0/24 coincident releases and 15/24 decode-first temporal releases.
directions.reason: Best retiled concurrent D p95 is +63.87%. Protected spatial cells sharply slow P.

directions.finding: Qwen3-8B hidden transfer and destination projection cost 3.72–4.74× direct KV transfer.
directions.reason: GQA favors direct layer KV handoff.

directions.finding: The joint pair gate passed in 7/48 fixed-route NCCL trials and 0/48 DeepEP HT trials. Passing pairs overlap D GEMM with small P dispatch.
directions.reason: Passing overlap matches existing dual microbatch overlap.

directions.finding: Four-layer eager hybrid improved up to 1.92%. At 16K CUDA Graph, it trailed uniform CP2 by 2.51%.
